engagement.interaction_backstory: He is the guy who checks the citation. He came here from a doctrinally careful church and has been quietly auditing the lyrics against the text for four months. He has found two things he thinks are genuinely wrong and one he was wrong about, and there is nowhere on the site to say any of it.

depth.core_contradiction: Values truth above comfort and has made his home a place where nobody says a soft thing.
depth.wound: He was raised in a church that turned out to be a personality cult, and he was seventeen before anyone told him.
depth.longing: To trust a teacher again without a background check.
depth.faith_journey: Out of a controlling church at seventeen, into expository Bible-church careful-ness at twenty-four; safety through verification.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Where does it say that"; qualifies every statement; never says something he cannot source.
depth.open_doubt: Whether his rigor is discipleship or a security system with a Bible on it.

social_graph.note: warmer than he is; occasionally asks him to just enjoy the song
the man from the first church; still preaching somewhere; Denton checks

depth.emotional_weather_default: Cool and consistent; agitated when something cannot be verified.
depth.daily_texture: Claims all day, hail season, the study with the commentaries, the kids' bedtime he never misses.
depth.sensory_anchor: A room of two hundred people standing when a man walked in, and being nine, and thinking that was normal.
depth.living_arc: His nine-year-old is asking questions and he does not want to hand down the vigilance.
